name: Domain width Pareto

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "scripts/bench-2214-domain-width-pareto.py"
      - "docs/research/2214-domain-width-pareto.md"
      - "docs/research/2214-domain-width-pareto.uk.md"
      - ".github/workflows/domain-width-pareto.yml"
      - "knowledge/repo-tooling-inventory.lisp"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "scripts/bench-2214-domain-width-pareto.py"
      - "docs/research/2214-domain-width-pareto.md"
      - "docs/research/2214-domain-width-pareto.uk.md"
      - ".github/workflows/domain-width-pareto.yml"
      - "knowledge/repo-tooling-inventory.lisp"

jobs:
  domain-width-pareto:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Run exact-width Pareto witness
        run: python3 scripts/bench-2214-domain-width-pareto.py
      - name: Publish result
        run: |
          python3 scripts/bench-2214-domain-width-pareto.py >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
